reaction.episode: Active CORRECTION through Oct 30: SPX 7,580.07 is -3.37% from its 120-day high, -1.52% below its 50-day but +3.7% above its 200-day. SMH at 522.49 is -22.23% from its high and BETWEEN_ZONES; NVDA at 204.64 is in Zone 1 ($200-210). VIX is 19.42 with no rollover, HY OAS is 3.44 and calm, and the mechanical capitulation tally is 2 of 4 — zone reached, not confirmed.
reaction.invalidation: An SPX close above 7,820 (the top of the failure zone) with SMH reclaiming $600 and VIX below ~16 would void the correction read and the stance with it; conversely HY OAS above 4% voids the ladder from the other side by breaking the regime.

ladder.response: Re-check the capitulation tally; if it reaches 3+ of 4, Tranche A deploys 25% per the ladder. If the tally is still below 3, hold Watch — a zone print alone is not a bottom.
ladder.trigger: SMH prints Zone 2 ($470-505) or NVDA prints Zone 2 ($175-185)

ladder.response: Treat as the trap case: no chase, no new adds. Rallies into the failure zone are sells, not entries.
ladder.trigger: Bounce into the failure zone: SPX rallies into 7,750-7,820 or SMH into $580-600 without a VIX rollover or volume-climax confirmation

ladder.response: Stand down — the ladder voids, no tranche deploys, and the stance moves to defensive Watch until credit and breadth re-confirm.
ladder.trigger: Stand-down: HY OAS breaks above 4%, or VIX closes above 25, or SPX closes below its 200-day (7,309.76)

ladder.response: Tranche A (25%) deploys per the ladder; Tranche B follows only on the standing oil-watch triggers (WTI at or below $90/$87), not on the bounce alone.
ladder.trigger: Re-entry: a second low holds above the Zone 2 floor with VIX rolling over from its spike and an SMH volume climax with intraday reversal confirmed

reaction.trapRisk: The pivot-and-fail scenario is the live risk: a first bounce into SPX 7,750-7,820 / SMH $580-600 that fails is the bull trap. Entries change accordingly — no chasing the first bounce, no sizing on NVDA Zone 1 alone at a 2-of-4 tally. Only a confirmed second low, or a Zone 2 print with the tally at 3+, earns size; everything before that is watching.

strategyPosture: Watch. The correction is active but no tranche trigger is met: NVDA is in Zone 1 but SMH sits between zones and the mechanical tally is 2 of 4. Credit is calm (HY OAS 3.44), so this is rotation, not rollover — no defensive exit — but no adds until Zone 2 prints or the tally confirms.

themes.counterRead: The divergence is real, not noise — GOOGL down 30.6% from its high is a genuine leadership break — but credit has not confirmed a rollover. Treat Mag 7 weakness as leadership rotation until HY OAS breaks 4% or SPX loses its 200-day. An index that is -3.37% off its high does not justify defensive exits; it justifies watching where the leadership goes next.

themes.counterRead: Price and fundamentals are moving in opposite directions across the whole stack — the classic data-ahead setup — but the tape has not confirmed a bottom: SMH sits between zones, NVDA is only in Zone 1, and the mechanical capitulation tally is 2 of 4 (no volume-climax reversal, no VIX rollover). The opportunity is real; the entry trigger is not yet met. Buying the washout before the tally confirms is catching, not positioning.

themes.counterRead: The declines are sentiment-driven while cash generation holds — the screen's own tags say so. That makes software a watchlist, not a buy: RSI readings in the low 30s can stay there for weeks, and no floor has formed. The names to own are the ones whose revenue inflection is RECOVERY with a durable moat (DDOG, NET), not the ones that merely fell the most.

themes.counterRead: VST is the tell: insider buying at the trough argues the long-term story is alive, but deteriorating revenue says the current price still carries story premium. A theme whose best name has a deteriorating revenue inflection is a narrative running ahead of its numbers — it needs a demand print, not a headline, before it is an opportunity rather than a falling knife.
themes.dataAnchor: OKLO is -32.59% in a month, SMR -29.48%, CCJ -12.27%, URA -16.11%, GEV -11.48%. VST is -31.2% from its high at $135.46, and its revenue inflection is DETERIORATING even as insiders bought $1.17M at the trough. The whole leg is giving back its momentum premium at once.
themes.label: Nuclear / AI power: story ahead of numbers

themes.watchFor: VST's revenue inflection moving off DETERIORATING, or OKLO/SMR printing a higher low after a roughly -30% month.

themes.counterRead: Positioning, not panic: VIX near 20 with HY OAS at 3.44 says the market is braced, not broken. The risk is a headline that converts a waiting tape into a directional one — either way, the levels decide, not the headlines. A midterm result or an Apple print does not change the ladder; it only changes the speed at which the tape reaches SPX 7,300 or SMH Zone 2.
